notes: Machine-readable record of the proprietary-blob source decision. See BLOB_SOURCES.md for the narrative and for what was actually executed.

route.name: official-lineageos-ota
route.rationale: LineageOS wiki documents that extract-files.py accepts a LineageOS installation ZIP; the official equuleus build is produced from the same four repositories this project pins.
route.supersedes: five-image reconstruction (beryllium V12.0.3.0.QEJMIXM, PNX RKQ1.200906.002, lemonadep TP1A.220624.003, lemonadep UKQ1.230924.001, caymanslm SKQ1.211103.001)

ota_format.method: HTTP range request for the first 1048576 bytes, parsed locally
ota_format.extract_utils_notes: ota-type=BLOCK means a block-based payload.bin; extract-utils handles it via extract_super_retrofit / lp.py / sparse_img.py. A full download is required because the payload sits mid-file.

execution_status.method: block-OTA (.new.dat.br + transfer.list) -> ext4 images -> debugfs dump -> list resolution -> tree generation
execution_status.not_the_same_as: extract-utils' extract-files.py; this route was implemented directly because the audit host has no synced PixelOS tree for Soong name resolution. See B01_EXTRACTION_REPORT.json for the full record.
execution_status.honesty_note: Both vendor trees were really generated and passed strict verification. This does NOT mean the ROM compiles or boots, and FOD/camera/NFC remain untested on hardware.

expected_gap_classes.why: LineageOS relocates some blobs; the list may name a different path
expected_gap_classes.handling: reported as MISSING with the expected path

expected_gap_classes.why: present in recovery.img, not in the OTA payload
expected_gap_classes.handling: documented per row; recovery.img is a separate recorded source

expected_gap_classes.why: the device tree may still list a blob the ROM no longer ships
expected_gap_classes.handling: reported; the correct fix is trimming the list, not substituting a file
